status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory run of docs/13 amendment A3, hypothesis H8.7 (context at constant cost). Validation split only; the test split is never loaded.
docs: docs/11 sections 11.2 to 11.7; docs/12 F19 and F20 (b) residues, (c) pooled EM, (d) pruning estimator; docs/13 amendment A3
seeds: none: the CVTM-core is deterministic given the data (docs/13 A3); uncertainty is the document-block bootstrap

data.byte_accounting: total negative log2-likelihood of the validation subword stream / UTF-8 bytes of the validation text (1,145,547), protocol CP
data.dataset_hashes: protocol.write_dataset_hashes(('train', 'validation')): tok and doc_start of both splits, validation text and doc_bytes, as results/20260923T042350Z_CP_anchor/dataset_hashes.json plus the document boundaries

frozen.note: the frozen CVTM-core of lane L0 (docs/11 11.6 on the full V 8000 train split, whole-document window, components S, D0..D4, P); the stage-1 files must still carry these sha256 (checked at start)

bootstrap.statistic: per resample: sum of bits / sum of UTF-8 bytes of the drawn documents (paired: of the differences)
bootstrap.label: derived

decisions_before_the_run.em_refit: REFIT PER N: for every window N the EM weights of docs/11 11.4 are refitted on H (the fit documents of 11.6) with document features computed at that window (CVTMCore.variant(window=N)); each N is a model variant fitted by the 11.6 protocol. The suffix clauses are those of the frozen core (the KN fits do not depend on N). The whole-document variant must reproduce the frozen weights bit for bit.
decisions_before_the_run.window_whole_document: 'whole' = window None (the whole document so far), the frozen core itself
decisions_before_the_run.timing_quantity: ns per token of the FULL scoring pass over every validation position: suffix lookups (model.suffix_gold), streaming document clauses (doc_clauses.doc_features_stream), mixture (gold_components, bucket_ids, gold_prob); its P(gold) must equal the batch scoring path bit for bit
decisions_before_the_run.timing_protocol: single thread (cpu_slot.sh 1, thread caps 1, no nice), one untimed warm-up pass per window, then 5 timed repeats with the two windows interleaved (16, 65536, 16, 65536, ...) to spread host drift over both; median per window; the stage medians are logged too
decisions_before_the_run.timing_label: contended (shared host): the CPU of other container processes during the timed repeats is logged; other host tenants are not visible
decisions_before_the_run.note_on_65536: the longest validation document has 23,717 tokens, so N = 65536 equals the whole-document window on this split

hypothesis: CVTM-core validation bits per byte with document window N in {0, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 16384, 65536, whole document}; ns per token of the scoring pass, single thread, median of 5 repeats

thresholds.text: (a) bits per byte non-increasing in N within 0.001; (b) per-token perplexity at N = 4096 at least 5 percent below N = 0; (c) ns per token at N = 65536 at most 1.5 times N = 16 (docs/13 A3 H8.7)

em.fit_rows: every position of H (304 documents, 1,397,702 tokens)

compute.memory_rule: memory.current + 26 GiB < 0.80 memory.max before loading the core, else wait (poll 2 minutes); mem_guard at its default limit

launch: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_a3_H8_7 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_7.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_a3_rows.py --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_a3_H8_7.json
